image_to_base64.name: image_to_base64
image_to_base64.description: Converts an image to an url-like Base64 string

override_mime_type.description: The mime type to use when converting the image. In case you want to override the default mime type. Example image/png

left.description: Specifies the horizontal position, indicating where the cropping starts from the left side of the image.

top.description: Represents the vertical position, indicating the starting point from the top of the image.

width.description: Determines the horizontal size of the cropped area.

height.description: Determines the vertical size of the cropped area.

resultFileName.description: Specifies the output file name for the cropped image (without extension).

degree.description: Specifies the degree of clockwise rotation applied to the image.

resultFileName.description: Specifies the output file name for the result image (without extension).

width.description: Specifies the width of the image.

height.description: Specifies the height of the image.

resultFileName.description: Specifies the output file name for the result image (without extension).

quality.description: Specifies the quality of the image after compression (0-100).

format.description: Specifies the format of the image after compression.

resultFileName.description: Specifies the output file name for the result image (without extension).

convert_image_format.name: convert_image_format
convert_image_format.description: Converts a image to supported formats

outputFormat.description: The format to convert the image to.

resultFileName.description: Specifies the output file name for the result image (without extension).
